keyEvents.text: Jacob Mendy (Bromley) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Bromley 0, Rotherham United 1. Sonny Aljofree (Rotherham United) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Josh Austerfield.
Goal! Bromley 0, Rotherham United 2. Tom Bradshaw (Rotherham United) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Aaron Nemane.
